subject: Upcoming Company Event: Annual Employee Appreciation Day
body: Dear Team, We are excited to announce that our annual Employee Appreciation Day is coming up next month! This is a great opportunity for us to show our gratitude for all your hard work and dedication. The event will include fun activities, delicious food, and recognition of outstanding employees. Please save the date and stay tuned for more details. We look forward to celebrating with you all! Best regards, HR Team
